name: Adult Broadcast / Streaming
description: Timed-text specification profile for general broadcast and streaming delivery.

max_cps.source: Standard streaming timed-text guideline (e.g. Netflix / BBC subtitle guide) for adult reading speeds

max_chars_per_line.source: Standard line limit for Latin script captions to prevent video obstruction and edge cropping

max_lines.source: EBU / FCC standard 2-line maximum for readability

min_duration_ms.source: 5/6 of a second (20 frames at 24fps), minimum eye recognition threshold

max_duration_ms.source: 7 seconds maximum to ensure synchronization with spoken dialog

min_gap_ms.source: 2 frames at 24fps (~83ms), ensures subtitle decoder clears between consecutive cues

sync_tolerance_ms.source: FCC 47 CFR 79.1 caption synchronicity standard (start within 0.5s of speech)

ad_overlap_tolerance_ms.source: Audio description overlap buffer, prevents AD narration from masking dialogue onset

ad_max_wpm.source: Descriptive Video Service standard spoken rate upper limit

accuracy.source: FCC caption quality accuracy benchmark (>= 98% word accuracy)

synchronicity.source: FCC caption synchronicity benchmark (>= 95% cues within 500ms tolerance)

completeness.source: FCC caption completeness benchmark (>= 98% dialogue represented)

readability.source: Streaming timed-text benchmark (>= 95% cues adhering to duration, speed, line rules)

sdh.source: SDH accessibility standard (>= 90% salient non-speech and off-screen cues tagged)

ad.source: Audio description accessibility benchmark (>= 90% essential visual events described)
